Hymn 137: Testimony
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Harry A. Dean

This is hymn number 137 titled "Testimony" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Harry A. Dean and the lyrics were written by Loren C. Dunn.
